info.title: VS Mart API
info.description:
VS Mart — grocery commerce + BNPL credit platform. Modular-monolith Django/DRF backend serving the Customer app, Agent app, Admin and Super-Admin consoles, and (upcoming) POS.

**Base URL:** `/api/v1`  ·  **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` (JWT).

**Response envelope** (all endpoints):
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "", "data": {}, "meta": {} }
```
Errors: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "error": { "code": "...", "message": "...", "fields": {} } }`.

**Casing:** the auth/user endpoints use snake_case keys (access_token, kyc_status, …) to match the Flutter models; everything else is camelCase.
